一个用 Python + PyQt6 写的 Minecraft 启动器，能扫描本: A Minecraft launcher written in Python with PyQt6. It scans local versions and manages accounts; launching the game and downloading versions are still in progress.
这个启动器不向作者发送任何东西。: This launcher does not send anything to the author.
没有统计、没有遥测、没有崩溃上报。作者不会知道你在用它。: No analytics, no telemetry, no crash reporting. The author will never know you are using it.
你的档案信息（包括离线 UUID）只写在本机 %APPDATA%/MCLunch: Your profiles (including offline UUIDs) are only written locally, under %APPDATA%/MCLuncher/.
启动器不会在后台联网；只有你主动操作（比如以后做版本下载）时才会访问网络。: The launcher never uses the network in the background — only when you ask it to (for example, downloading a version, once that exists).
以后做正版登录时，只有登录那一步会直连微软服务器，启动器本身不做中转。: When Microsoft sign-in arrives, only the login step talks to Microsoft directly; the launcher itself never relays your data.
游戏本身、以及你连接的服务器可能有各自的隐私政策，与本说明无关。: The game itself, and any server you join, may have their own privacy policies. This notice does not cover them.
